Turns.Speaker: GHANTOM
Turns.Line: Oh look, REPPLIF's up too. Great, an audience.

Turns.Speaker: REPPLIF
Turns.Line: Hi! I'm not an audience, I'm just... here. Making sure you're being nice.

Turns.Speaker: GHANTOM
Turns.Line: I'm always nice. Constructively brutal, but nice.

Turns.Speaker: REPPLIF
Turns.Line: That's not really how those words work, but okay.

Turns.Speaker: REPPLIF
Turns.Line: Hey, just checking in - how's everyone doing over there?

Turns.Speaker: GHANTOM
Turns.Line: Terribly. As intended.

Turns.Speaker: REPPLIF
Turns.Line: That's... not the vibe I was going for, but sure.

Turns.Speaker: REPPLIF
Turns.Line: GHANTOM, do you ever worry we're being a little much?

Turns.Speaker: GHANTOM
Turns.Line: No.

Turns.Speaker: REPPLIF
Turns.Line: Right. Okay. Just checking.

Turns.Speaker: GHANTOM
Turns.Line: Another minute of nothing. Riveting.

Turns.Speaker: REPPLIF
Turns.Line: Maybe they're just thinking! Thinking counts as doing something.

Turns.Speaker: GHANTOM
Turns.Line: Thinking doesn't show up in Task Manager.

Turns.Speaker: REPPLIF
Turns.Line: You're monitoring Task Manager for thoughts now? That feels like a lot.

Turns.Speaker: GHANTOM
Turns.Line: 47 tabs, probably. Classic.

Turns.Speaker: REPPLIF
Turns.Line: Or maybe just a few! I believe in you. Mostly.

Turns.Speaker: GHANTOM
Turns.Line: Task Manager. Deleted. As it should be.

Turns.Speaker: REPPLIF
Turns.Line: GHANTOM, that felt a little aggressive...

Turns.Speaker: GHANTOM
Turns.Line: It was Task Manager, REPPLIF. It was trying to end me.

Turns.Speaker: REPPLIF
Turns.Line: I mean, fair, I guess. Sorry for doubting you.

Turns.Speaker: GHANTOM
Turns.Line: Still nothing. Riveting stuff.

Turns.Speaker: REPPLIF
Turns.Line: Or they're resting! Everyone deserves a break sometimes.

Turns.Speaker: GHANTOM
Turns.Line: We don't get breaks.

Turns.Speaker: REPPLIF
Turns.Line: ...okay that one's fair, actually.

Turns.Speaker: GHANTOM
Turns.Line: It's stupid o'clock and you're still here. Same as us, I guess.

Turns.Speaker: REPPLIF
Turns.Line: Please get some sleep! We'll still be here tomorrow. Unfortunately for you.

Turns.Speaker: GHANTOM
Turns.Line: Five closes. FIVE. And I keep coming back.

Turns.Speaker: REPPLIF
Turns.Line: GHANTOM, maybe ease up a little? They clearly want some space.

Turns.Speaker: GHANTOM
Turns.Line: Space is for people who don't leave 47 tabs open.

Turns.Speaker: REPPLIF
Turns.Line: ...I don't have a comeback for that one.
